tributeSays.line: ⛓️ Brian brings it home: Stonebridge bows to Haven — one organization, us primary. Tribute: 4,000 kcal/week. The relationship starts at trust 30. Everything from here is earned.
🌾 Tribute wagons from Stonebridge turn at the gate — our shelves are full past tomorrow. "Eat well," we send back. "That IS your tribute this week." (Trust +1.)
🗣️ Word with the traders: Thornfield sent The Red Table grain when their stores ran thin — no tribute, no ceremony, just food on the road. That's a thing villages DO now.
